I'll attach the demo recording for your internal review. If this timeline looks good, we'll aim to get the sample export and schema to you within 48 hours.

Rishi / Olga / Laura,

Attached are the artifacts we can share immediately:
- who_viewed_when_sample_20270403.csv (sanitized sample, 10 rows)
- audit-schema.md (field-by-field description and masking policy)

High level answers to PayWell's questions:
1) Actor identifiers: we include actor_type (internal_service_account | customer_user | api_key) and actor_id. By default on Hosted we pseudonymize customer user ids (SHA-256 + salt) in exports; on Dedicated and Private we can provide reversible identifiers if the customer requires them and agrees to data handling terms.
2) Requester IP: we capture request_ip for all requests. For Hosted exports, request_ip is marked as restricted by default and can be included for enterprise customers under an export agreement; on Dedicated/Private it's available for exports.
3) Formats: we support CSV and JSONL exports. The sample CSV is attached. For very large exports we recommend JSONL compressed with gzip.
4) Retention: Hosted default retention for detailed request logs is 90 days. We offer an enterprise retention add-on (configurable to multi-year windows); Dedicated deployments can be configured for longer retention by request. Operationally, retaining 7 years requires a dedicated storage plan and a small ops SLA change — estimate: additional 12–18% on storage & retrieval costs depending on retention tier.
5) Encryption/KMS: Exports at rest and in transit are encrypted. For Dedicated/Private we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) and can sign exports with an attestation.

Next steps I recommend:
- Send PayWell the two attachments and a short cover note (Olga) summarizing what is standard on Hosted vs what we can provide on Dedicated with the enterprise retention add-on.
- If PayWell wants reversible user_ids on Hosted we need an exception and a signed data handling addendum — propose we push them to Dedicated for that requirement.

Attachments: who_viewed_when_sample_20270403.csv (10-row sanitized sample), audit-schema.md

Let me know if you want a quick sync with PayWell's compliance team; happy to join.

--
